title: Modular engine assembly and telemetry
summary: Cylinder tooltips describe manifold sharing, and composite output names three data channels.
body: The 1x1 cylinder attaches to a crankshaft and needs manifolds for air, fuel and exhaust. Directly adjacent cylinders can share a manifold according to the supplied tooltip. Cylinder composite values 1, 2 and 3 are air volume, fuel volume and temperature. The starter attaches to a drive belt, and the alternator converts drive belt energy to electric charge.

findings.label: Modular Engine Cylinder 1x1: Composite Data
findings.value: Outputs data from the cylinder. (Value 1 : Air Volume) (Value 2 : Fuel Volume) (Value 3 : Temperature)
findings.detail: Shipped connection description. This documents the interface; it is not a runtime measurement.

findings.label: Modular Engine Cylinder 1x1
findings.value: Attach a cylinder to a crankshafts outer surface to produce power for an engine. The cylinder requires a manifold to move air, fuel, and exhaust through the cylinder. Cylinders that are chained directly adjacent to each other can share a single manifold.

findings.label: Modular Engine Air Manifold
findings.value: Attach a manifold to a cylinder to provide a connection for air to that cylinder. Cylinders that are chained directly adjacent to each other can share a single manifold.

findings.label: Modular Engine Fuel Manifold
findings.value: Attach a manifold to a cylinder to provide a connection for fuel to that cylinder. Cylinders that are chained directly adjacent to each other can share a single manifold.

findings.label: Modular Engine Starter
findings.value: Attach a starter to a Drive Belt component and supply power to apply an inefficient force on the engine to get it started.

findings.label: Modular Engine Alternator
findings.value: Alternators convert mechanical energy from a Drive Belt into electric charge.

limitations: Block definitions document configuration and interfaces. Generic serialized fields can exist on unrelated block types; only relevant fields are selected here.
These are supplied resources. No game process was executed, and native code loading, overrides and effective runtime values remain unverified.

The resources inspected do not establish an optimal air-fuel ratio, stoichiometry, efficiency curve or fuel-to-power equation. Composite volume and temperature units are not given in the selected channel description.
